findings.message: 5 headline(s) switch typeface or to italic mid-line (the "one italic serif word" move).
findings.fix: Set the whole headline in one face. Emphasis comes from the words.

findings.message: 6 eyebrow/kicker label(s) above headings: "Pahrump, Nevada real estate" above "Find your place in the valley."; "Meet your Realtor" above "Experience that moves you forward."; "Make your next move" above "Find your dream home."; "How we help" above "Real estate, handled with care."; "For sellers" above "Don't just list it. Get it sold."
findings.fix: Delete them. If the label carried real information, fold it into the headline or the supporting sentence.
Remove them. If order truly matters, write it into the words ("First, …") or use a real <ol>.

findings.message: 19 tiny uppercase letter-spaced labels (e.g. "Pahrump, Nevada real estate", "Years in real estate", "The Ridge Realty Group", "Meet your Realtor").
findings.fix: Use sentence-case text at a readable size, or delete the label.
Remove. Use words or real imagery.

findings.message: 1 gradient fill(s): div.absolute.inset-0 → linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(14, 30, 24, 0.88), rgba(14, 30, 24, 0.3))
findings.fix: Use a flat colour or a real image. The only gradient allowed by default is a neutral scrim over a photo for legibility.

findings.message: 6 thin rule(s)/divider line(s): header.absolute.inset-x-0 1440px | div.mt-10.grid 736px | div.divide-y.divide-[#d8d1c6] 1344px | article.group.grid 1344px
findings.fix: Delete. Separate with space, a tone change, or scale. Lines are only for real tables and form fields.
Prefer a filled surface or no box.
Use the drawn palette. If you want warmth, take a low-chroma stone or bone, not a yellow cream.

findings.message: Low-contrast text: "Make your next move" 2.8:1 needs 4.5:1; "Call or visit" 3.4:1 needs 4.5:1; "Meet your Realtor" 4.1:1 needs 4.5:1; "in sales closed in 2021" 4.1:1 needs 4.5:1
findings.fix: Darken or lighten the text colour.
A page needs about five: display, heading, lead, body, small.

findings.message: Body text is 14px (the size most of the running text is set in).
findings.fix: Body copy 16–20px. Map small sizes from blueprints onto your body step.

findings.message: The running text is a soft grey on its ground (1.1:1).
findings.fix: Set body copy in the full ink (7:1 or more). Keep the muted ink for secondary notes; pages read thin and unfinished when everything is grey.

findings.message: No video anywhere on the page.
findings.fix: Look for one honest clip with scripts/assets.mjs --video (the place, the material, the process) and use it as a muted loop with a poster frame. Defend its absence only if no clip fits the subject.
Nothing meant to be read goes below 13px.

findings.message: Only 1 element(s) moved while the page loaded and scrolled.
findings.fix: Build the motion layer (SKILL.md step 9, references/motion.md): the signature move, an entrance for the parts of every section, feedback on every control, and one moving picture. Transform and opacity only, with a reduced-motion fallback.

findings.message: 3 headline(s) wrap past two lines at 768px: "Real estate done right" → 4 lines (4 words, 36px); "Commercial & residential" → 3 lines (3 words, 36px); "Expertise you can rely on" → 3 lines (5 words, 36px)
findings.fix:
Cut words first (a headline is a title, not a sentence). Then give it a wider measure. Lower the size only as a last resort and never below the scale you chose. A real statement paragraph belongs in a

or

at 32px or less.

findings.message: A section carries text but no heading: section#about.bg-[#f3efe6].px-5 at 760px.
findings.fix: Name it with a short heading unless it is the continuation of the section above.
